Method of Attack: Drops Lua-based malware on infected MikroTik routers
Exploits zero-day vulnerability in MikroTik RouterOS Winbox service to steal user database file and decrypt user details
Discoverer: Kaspersky Lab security researcher Costin Raiu
Impacted Systems: MikroTik routers running RouterOS versions since v6.29
Attack Vector: Winbox remote management service (port 8291) exploited via zero-day vulnerability
